exposure: indications for cesarean delivery (e.g., obstructed labor)
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery at Ayder Specialized Comprehensive Hospital, Mekelle, Tigray, Ethiopia in 2017.
finding: Not booking for antenatal care and having a previous cesarean delivery were associated with unfavorable maternal outcomes, while obstructed labor was associated with unfavorable fetal outcomes.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was reported as an outcome, affecting 17.2% of the newborns, but the specific weight criteria are not defined.
